verdict.rationale: Kimi documents a public, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API. It has a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, a Try-it playground, member API keys via the Kimi Code Console, and an Admin API, so model inference, files, batches and tool calls can be driven programmatically. A probe found that the consumer assistant app itself (agent mode, memory, scheduled tasks, PPT and other features) has no public API; the platform API is a separate pay-as-you-go product. Missing for 10: API coverage of the assistant app's own agent/task features, an API changelog and deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
